interpretation_notes.note: Correctness applies only to the three fixed probe inputs in each question. The intervention is interpreted as changing the source policy before a fresh program load; imported aliases in an already running process are not patched. This is not general whole-program change impact.

Direct calls are syntactic calls in the requested function body, across possible branches. There are no concrete execution inputs in these questions. Transitive callees and builtins/string methods are excluded.

Questions explicitly request sorted lists. A correct unordered membership set still fails the fixed primary metric if order is wrong. Define primary results as correct code answer plus output-instruction adherence. Report order-only failures as a separate diagnostic without changing the fixed primary scoring.

All tested policies, constants, functions and literal values exist in the retrievable project source. Whether a specific arm actually packs those sources is a retrieval outcome, not a missing-dataset-answer issue.

The six domains use distinct algorithms but share policy/rules/service layout and common ancillary files. These are small synthetic programs, not independent samples of production repository architectures.
